stages.title: Stage 1: Self Introduction
stages.description: Learn to introduce yourself, your job, where you live, and your hobbies.
stages.initial_ruku_message: Hello! I am Ruku, your English speaking partner. Let's start simple! Can you tell me your name and where you are from?

stages.title: Stage 2: Daily Routine
stages.description: Describe what you do from morning to night using present simple tense.
stages.initial_ruku_message: Welcome to Stage 2! Tell me about your typical morning. What time do you wake up and what is the first thing you do?

stages.title: Stage 3: Ordering Food at a Cafe
stages.description: Practice ordering breakfast, coffee, and asking for the bill politely.
stages.initial_ruku_message: Welcome to Ruku's Cafe! I am your barista today. What can I get started for you?

stages.title: Stage 4: Asking for Directions
stages.description: Learn how to ask for and give directions in a new city.
stages.initial_ruku_message: Excuse me! Imagine you are lost in London. Ask me how to get to the nearest metro station or museum.

stages.title: Stage 5: Past Travel Memories
stages.description: Practice past tense by sharing an unforgettable trip or vacation.
stages.initial_ruku_message: I love traveling! What is the most memorable trip or city you have visited, and why did you like it?

stages.title: Stage 6: Expressing Opinions & Hobbies
stages.description: Share your thoughts on movies, books, music, or current trends.
stages.initial_ruku_message: What kind of movies or shows do you enjoy watching in your free time? Tell me about your favorite one!

stages.title: Stage 7: Shopping & Polite Bargaining
stages.description: Negotiate prices, check clothing sizes, and ask for discounts.
stages.initial_ruku_message: Hello, welcome to our store! Are you looking for anything specific today?

stages.title: Stage 8: Friends & Workplace Chat
stages.description: Casual watercooler conversations and catching up with friends.
stages.initial_ruku_message: Long time no see! How has work and family been lately? Any exciting news?

stages.title: Stage 9: Job Interview Simulation
stages.description: Face realistic HR questions: strengths, weaknesses, and behavioral scenarios.
stages.initial_ruku_message: Good morning. Thank you for attending this interview. To begin, could you walk me through your professional background?

stages.title: Stage 10: Business Meeting & Presentation
stages.description: Pitch a project idea, lead a discussion, and handle critical feedback.
stages.initial_ruku_message: Welcome team. Let's discuss our quarterly project goals. How would you propose we improve user engagement this month?

stages.title: Stage 11: Debate & Complex Discussion
stages.description: Engage in nuanced discussions about AI, education, and modern society.
stages.initial_ruku_message: Do you believe Artificial Intelligence will replace human jobs, or create new opportunities? Share your viewpoint.

stages.title: Stage 12: IELTS Speaking Mock Exam
stages.description: Full mock test format covering Part 1, Part 2 (Cue card), and Part 3 analysis.
stages.initial_ruku_message: This is your IELTS Speaking Mock Test. In Part 1, I will ask some general questions about yourself. Let's begin: Do you work or study?
